rationale: The only remaining high advisories are in image-size through Expo and React Native Metro build tooling. The shipped app does not expose Metro asset inspection to remote user input. This exception is exact, owned, and time-limited; CI rejects a changed advisory set or any additional high or critical finding.

blockedUpgradePaths.blockedBy: The npm registry currently reports 2.0.2 as the latest image-size release, while both advisories affect versions through 2.0.2. Metro also still contains file-path based image-size call sites.
blockedUpgradePaths.revisitWhen: A patched image-size release and compatible Metro call sites are available.
